definition: The rate a perpetual's longs pay its shorts (or shorts pay longs when negative) at each funding settlement, set from the perp's premium to its index.
boundaries: A carry the venue charges peer to peer, not a broker's swap: the daily FX swap is rollover-swap-cost@1. The instrument record's funding_interval and funding_source name the venue's clock; perp-funding-settlement-clock@1 measures the time to the next one.
recognition: Strongly positive funding reads as crowded longs.

class_meanings.fx: No funding: the daily swap is a broker-quoted rate differential, rollover-swap-cost@1.
class_meanings.metal: No funding: a CFD's overnight swap, rollover-swap-cost@1.
class_meanings.index_cfd: No funding: a CFD's overnight financing and dividend adjustment.
class_meanings.commodity_cfd: No funding: a CFD's overnight swap.
class_meanings.stock_cfd: No funding: a CFD's overnight financing.
class_meanings.future: No funding: the carry sits in the basis and falls to zero at expiry.
class_meanings.perp: Paid peer to peer at each settlement, every 8 hours or every hour by venue.

sources.quote: Funding on Hyperliquid is capped at 4%/hour
Perp funding: peer to peer, every 8 h or 1 h, from the perp-index premium
